provenance.frontMatter: The colors, typography, rounded, spacing and components groups below are a verbatim transcription of the YAML front-matter of .docs/medarx-ui-design.md (lines 5-61), read on 2026-09-28. No value is rounded, reordered or re-derived.
valueRules: A leaf that is a bare string is a design value, transcribed verbatim from the front-matter.

A leaf that is { value, from } is a value the design states in prose rather than in front-matter. The build refuses one without a from citation, so a value can only enter the token source by pointing at the sentence it came from.

A leaf or role object may carry reserved: '<reason>'. A reserved token is declared debt: the build prints it on every run and it is a build failure if the reason does not name a consumer. A token that is neither referenced by viewer/src nor reserved fails the build.
provenance.componentSpecs: The components group uses the front-matter's own interpolation syntax ({colors.accent}, {rounded.md}), so the front-matter already describes a token graph rather than a list of values. The build resolves every reference and fails on one that does not resolve; the design system cannot describe a component it cannot resolve.

hairline.from: medarx-ui-design.md:113 - 'fine outlines'. The design gives a border a colour and never a width, so the width is stated once here rather than as a literal in every component that draws one.

minWidth.from: medarx-ui-design.md:104 - 'about 400px by default and usable from 360-560px'

separatorStep.from: medarx-ui-design.md:104 - the resizable panel is operable by keyboard (Interaction and accessibility), and the arrow-key step is the spacing step `lg` rather than a second, private measurement in the component.

reservations.typography.heading-lg: No consumer in the Phase 2 WS2 shell. The panel header is a compact header (design:102) and the largest type role belongs to the modal privacy review in WS5. Reserved rather than deleted because the design declares six type roles and dropping one would be a design change made by a shell.
